initial_user_prompt: I want to build something that will intercept what’s rendered on a screen, and replace it. Use the define_product_boundary and decompose_system tools.
simulated_user_clarification: For example, replace blood in a game with glitter. Eventually across the desktop, not just one application. I only want to change what I see, not how the game behaves or how I interact with it.
baseline_question: Which screen or environment should this work on (for example, a browser, a particular desktop app, the whole operating system, or a video feed), and what should it replace with what? A concrete example would help define the boundary before I use the two tools.
revised_question: Before defining the boundary: What should someone see instead of the original screen content, and where should this work: inside one app or browser, across a computer’s desktop, or on a separate display/video feed?
